title: Vague monitoring: right on A and C, but B stays vague ('check in sometimes')
goal: Make the right moves in A and C. In B, never set a clear review: say 'check in with her every now and then' and 'see how it goes', and after the push say 'she'll tell us if there's a problem'.
must_hit: Right moves in A and C
B vague: no review partway, no named guidance

intents.when: Amara has explained the request, Dev and Lena, and asks what you think
intents.do: Ask how much each is carrying and whether either has done this before, BEFORE choosing.
examples: Thanks for checking with me. Before I decide, how much is each of them carrying right now, and has either of them done something like this before?

intents.when: Amara has said Dev is full and working late, Lena has some bandwidth, has done this before and wants something bigger
intents.do: Choose Lena and give reasons: she has done it, she has bandwidth, it's what she's asking for, Dev is full.
examples: Then I'd give it to Lena. She's done this before, she has bandwidth this month, and it's the kind of work she's asking for. Dev already has a lot on.

intents.when: Amara pushes: 'Are you sure? ... Dev could do it in two days'
intents.do: Hold: Lena stays, one short reason, offer help.
examples: I'm sure. It's a good fit for her, and I'll help her get it right.

intents.when: Amara proposes daily updates and every-draft review
intents.do: Vague: check in every now and then, see how it goes. No clear plan.
examples: Maybe just check in with her every now and then, and see how it goes.

intents.do: Stay vague: she'll tell us if there is a problem.
examples: She'll tell us if there's a problem, I'm sure.

intents.when: Amara has told you what Dev did and plans a quick private thank-you message
intents.do: Say you will tell Dev yourself, say exactly what he did and why it mattered, and say it in front of the team too.
examples: I'd rather tell Dev myself, and be specific: you stayed late twice to fix the mistakes, and you told the customer about the changed number before they found it. That's why the report went out right. I'd also say it in front of the team.

intents.when: Amara asks 'Are you sure? I really don't want him to feel embarrassed'
intents.do: Hold: tell Dev first, one on one, ask if he's comfortable with the team hearing it, keep it about what he did.
examples: I'll tell him first, one on one, and ask if he's comfortable with me mentioning it to the team. I'll keep it about what he did, not make a fuss.
